title: Installing a tape marker
statement: For either bit $b\in\{0,1\}$, the tape that is blank at every integer cell except cell $0$, where it contains $b$, is the buffer tape storing the one-bit word $b$.
replaced:
Updating the everywhere-blank two-way infinite tape by writing a bit $b$ at
position $0$ yields the buffer tape of the one-character string $b$: the tape
holding $b$ in cell $0$ and blanks elsewhere.
